text:
Priya (partner-eng): Quick sync — prepping the governance snapshot for the cloud marketplace joint listing with Edgeware SI + Acme HW. Need final SOC2 attestation, pen-test report or executive summary, and an artifact redaction plan. Timeline: target listing in 3 weeks.
Luca (security): Thanks — do we have a firm date for the SI's pen window? scope (external/internal)?
Priya (partner-eng): SI said external web + API only. Pen window TBD but they'd like to run in 10 days.
Nina (partner-ops): Heads up — SI legal said raw pen PDFs may include customer data. They'll only permit sanitized versions or presigned artifact access for us.
Mason (infra): Presigned S3 approach is fine. We'll ask for filenames and TTL. Sample presign cmd: `aws s3 presign s3://acme-uploads/edgeware/pen-report.pdf --expires-in 604800`
Devon (partner-eng): Also need cert chain for HW attestation and list of firmware images used in tests. Could be separate secure bucket.
Luca (security): For SOC2 we only need the report cover + auditor letter and the control narrative relevant to our boundary. Full SOC often has PII — plan to pull only sections.
Priya (partner-eng): Can we get a checklist of exactly which sections we accept vs which must be redacted? I want to send to SI to speed up.
compliance-bot: Added task #PL-758: "Define accepted SOC2 sections + pen-report redaction template" to Compliance board (owner: Luca). Deadline 3 business days.
Luca (security): I'll draft a minimal allowed-sections list: executive summary, auditor opinion, and control descriptions for infrastructure and access controls. Everything with customer identifiers redacted.
Nina (partner-ops): SI prefers a template for redaction so their legal can approve quickly. Can we share a one-pager?
Mason (infra): From infra side we'll need logs retention statement and KMS key policy snippet for the dedicated provs. Suggest we provide a sample KMS policy they can mirror.
Priya (partner-eng): Good call. Devon — can you coordinate with Edgeware SI to request: 1) presigned sanitized SOC2 PDF (7d TTL) 2) presigned sanitized pen exec summary (7d TTL) 3) firmware manifest + attestation chain 4) consent to store artifacts in our compliance bucket?
Devon (partner-eng): On it. I'll ask for AWS presign links, and a redaction sample. Also will propose a weekly 30m triage call (Wed 11am PT) until listing complete.
Luca (security): One more: we need scope mapping between SI's test cases and our threat model. If pen report lacks mapping, ask for a short mapping doc.
Nina (partner-ops): Noted. I'll draft the redaction one-pager and attach the sample KMS policy.
Priya (partner-eng): Thanks — can everyone ack when they have their artifact templates ready? I'll compile and send to SI legal by EOD tomorrow.
Mason (infra): Ack — I'll prepare KMS snippet + retention statement by EOD.
Luca (security): Ack — I'll produce the allowed-sections list + mapping template by EOD.
Devon (partner-eng): Ack — I'll request presigned links and redaction confirmation; will update this thread with links when they come through.
Nina (partner-ops): Ack — redaction one-pager in progress.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 48 hours for task #PL-758.
Priya (partner-eng): Great. If SI pushes back on presigns, fallback is to request a sanitized PDF bundle plus an attestation letter from SI's security lead. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
Devon (partner-eng): noted, will flag if they require alternate flow.
Luca (security): Cool. Post any sample artifacts here (use presigned links only). If anyone needs an NDA addendum template to allow fuller access, ping me.
Priya (partner-eng): Thanks team — I'll post the message to Edgeware SI after I collect the templates.
